lines.text: In March, Beijing was still cold, and Jiang Che walked toward a different battlefield.
lines.text_zh: 三月，北京仍然寒冷，江彻走向了另一种战场。

lines.text: Nervous?
lines.text_zh: 紧张吗？

lines.text: A little. I have never spoken in front of so many people.
lines.text_zh: 有点。我从没在这么多人面前演讲过。

lines.text: This time, it is not technology. This time, it is the truth.
lines.text_zh: 这次不是技术，这次是真相。

lines.text: He walked onto the stage with a piece of ice in his hand.
lines.text_zh: 他手里握着一块冰，走上了舞台。

lines.text: This ice core is from Antarctica. Its bubbles hold air from five hundred years ago.
lines.text_zh: 这块冰芯来自南极。它的气泡封存着五百年前的空气。

lines.text: Antarctica is not just land. It is Earth's climate archive.
lines.text_zh: 南极不只是一片土地。它是地球的气候档案馆。

lines.text: The data on the screen told a story of melting glaciers and shrinking habitats.
lines.text_zh: 屏幕上的数据讲述着冰川消融和栖息地缩小的故事。

lines.text: My father drew this map. Each X is a monitoring point. The red dot is different.
lines.text_zh: 这张地图是我父亲画的。每个 X 是一个监测点。这个红点不一样。

lines.text: The Antarctic Treaty forbids commercial mining, but someone wanted to break that rule.
lines.text_zh: 《南极条约》禁止商业开采，但有人想打破这条规则。

lines.text: He pressed play. A voice from the recording filled the hall.
lines.text_zh: 他按下播放键。录音的声音充满了整个礼堂。

lines.text: The treaty is paper. Find the right mining technology, and no one will stop us.
lines.text_zh: 条约只是一张纸。找到合适的开采技术，就没人能阻止我们。

lines.text: The audience gasped. Cameras flashed like stars.
lines.text_zh: 观众倒吸一口凉气。相机闪光灯像星星一样闪烁。

lines.text: If we destroy Antarctica for profit, we lose more than ice. We lose hope.
lines.text_zh: 如果我们为了利益破坏南极，失去的不只是冰，而是希望。

lines.text: Even in extreme cold, life finds a way. We should protect that life.
lines.text_zh: 即使在极寒中，生命也能找到出路。我们应该保护这样的生命。

lines.text: The applause began as a few scattered beats, then became a roaring tide.
lines.text_zh: 掌声起初是零星的几下，然后变成了轰鸣的潮水。

lines.text: After the speech, the dinner was held in the school cafeteria. Simple dishes, warm hearts.
lines.text_zh: 演讲结束后，晚宴在学校食堂举办。简单的菜肴，温暖的心。

lines.text: You did well, but Chen Zongjian will fight back.
lines.text_zh: 你做得很好，但陈总监会反击。

lines.text: Then what should we do?
lines.text_zh: 那我们该怎么办？

lines.text: Strike first. I have collected Hengyuan's violation records.
lines.text_zh: 先发制人。我已经搜集了恒远的违规记录。

lines.text: I believe you because your foolishness is really idealism.
lines.text_zh: 我相信你，因为你的傻其实是理想主义。

lines.text: In the dim light of the cafeteria, her eyes held something fierce and pure.
lines.text_zh: 在食堂昏黄的灯光下，她的眼睛里有一种近乎执拗的忠诚。

lines.text: Then, the door opened. A man in a dark grey suit stood at the entrance, two bodyguards behind him.
lines.text_zh: 然后，门开了。一个穿深灰色西装的男人站在门口，身后两个保镖。

lines.text: Jiang Che, may I have a word? I am here to negotiate.
lines.text_zh: 江彻，可以谈谈吗？我是来谈判的。

lines.text: Mr. Chen, this is harassment. If you do not leave, I will call the police.
lines.text_zh: 陈先生，这是骚扰。如果你不离开，我会报警。

lines.text: We will abandon the mining plan if Jiang Che retracts his accusations.
lines.text_zh: 如果江彻撤回指控，我们会放弃开采计划。

lines.text: My accusations are accurate. The recording is real, the data is real, the map is real.
lines.text_zh: 我的指控是准确的。录音是真实的，数据是真实的，地图是真实的。

lines.text: A woman in a United Nations uniform stepped forward from the crowd.
lines.text_zh: 一个穿联合国制服的女人从人群中走出。

lines.text: I am Maria Gonzalez, a UN Environment Programme representative. I heard every word.
lines.text_zh: 我是玛丽亚·冈萨雷斯，联合国环境规划署代表。我听完了每一句话。

lines.text: Commercial mining in Antarctica violates the treaty and may become an international crime.
lines.text_zh: 在南极商业开采违反条约，也可能构成国际犯罪。

lines.text: Abandon the plan. No one wants a court summons after retirement.
lines.text_zh: 放弃计划吧。没人想在退休后收到法庭传票。

lines.text: Chen Zongjian's face turned from red to pale to ashen. He turned and walked out without a word.
lines.text_zh: 陈总监的脸色从红润变成苍白，再变成铁青。他转身一言不发地走了出去。

lines.text: That night, Jiang Che received a video call from his parents.
lines.text_zh: 那天晚上，江彻收到了父母的视频通话。

lines.text: We watched your speech live. You did well. Better than we imagined.
lines.text_zh: 我们看了你的演讲直播。你做得很好。比我们想象的还要好。

lines.text: You said exactly what your father said on the ice fifteen years ago.
lines.text_zh: 你说的和你父亲十五年前在冰原上说的完全一样。

lines.text: Chen is not alone. Other companies also want Antarctic mineral data.
lines.text_zh: 陈不是唯一一个。其他公司也想得到南极矿产数据。

lines.text: Protect Antarctica for all humanity.
lines.text_zh: 为全人类守护南极。

lines.text: We will. Until the last moment.
lines.text_zh: 我们会的。直到最后一刻。
